ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using DismHost
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using DismHost DLL hijacking (UACMe 63)

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\DismHost\\\.exe.*")) AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
